sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/task_service.ts
sources.finding: Shared human/agent service creates UUID tasks with name,description,stage,one user/agent assignee and draft/in_progress/completed state. Start checks assignee and existing session run; changes synchronize/cancel open runs. Creation always sets parentTaskId:null,rootTaskId:self; schema hierarchy is not an exposed hierarchy feature.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/db/schema/tasks.ts
sources.finding: Task and run are separate records; unique unfinished run per task and unique session links constrain duplicates. No task dependency/priority/label/comment entities appear here.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/system_commands/task_management.ts
sources.finding: Agent system commands call the same company-scoped task service for list/create/update/delete, preserving creator agent and session context.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/system_command_service.ts
sources.finding: Requires the named system skill active for the session before dispatching registered management commands; a tool ID alone does not authorize execution.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/pi-mono/session_manager_service.ts
sources.finding: Runs embedded Pi coding-agent with company tools and selected model/credential; default Pi tools disabled. Reconstructs in-memory session from persisted context snapshot; initializes provider API auth in memory and supports reasoning/model settings. This is not Claude/Codex CLI execution.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/pi-mono/companyhelm_resource_loader.ts
sources.finding: Custom loader deliberately returns empty disk AGENTS/skills/extensions/prompts; company template and explicit session modules supply instructions. External repo instructions must be read by tools, not assumed auto-loaded.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/pi-mono/modules/skills.ts
sources.finding: Company skills/catalog activation adds instructions and eligible system commands to current session; separate from arbitrary Pi filesystem plugins.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/pi-mono/tools/mcp/service.ts
sources.finding: Discovers enabled MCP servers attached to agent, resolves company-scoped headers and executes namespaced tools.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/mcp/runtime/client.ts
sources.finding: Actual StreamableHTTP MCP SDK transport with headers and request timeout; no standalone CompanyHelm management MCP server.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/workers/session_process.ts
sources.finding: Server BullMQ workers execute sessions with configured worker concurrency; browser connection is not worker lifetime.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/process/queue.ts
sources.finding: Wake jobs retry three attempts with exponential2000ms backoff; no deterministic job ID, relying on per-session lease.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/process/lease.ts
sources.finding: Redis NX/PX30000 token lease; compare-token heartbeat/release prevents two workers driving same session.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/process/execution.ts
sources.finding: Lease loss aborts Pi runtime; queued steer/interrupt messages and context snapshots persist operational state. Re-enqueues pending work after lease release; not exactly-once external tool side effects.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/session_lifecycle_service.ts
sources.finding: Persisted session ownership and status; archived-session deletion; context fork; interruption. User mutations reject other owners, while internal agent calls with no user follow service context.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/session_prompt_service.ts
sources.finding: Queued prompts carry principal metadata; user calls check owner when non-null. Supports JPEG/PNG inputs. Not unrestricted company-wide coprompting.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/conversations/delivery_planner.ts
sources.finding: Agent message targets an agent or session, can create/reuse a target session and enqueue steering with source agent/session attribution.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/conversations/loop_guard.ts
sources.finding: Narrow220-character acknowledgement-pattern guard prevents some ping-pong; no general multi-agent termination proof.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/workflows/service.ts
sources.finding: Persistent workflow definitions/ordered steps and required inputs; cron enabled/overlap checks skip existing running trigger and record started/skipped/failed schedule outcomes.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/workflows/execution_session_service.ts
sources.finding: OSS step status is pending/running/done; marking running resets previous running step to pending; all steps done completes run. Agent status update is not test/approval enforcement.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/workflows/scheduler_sync.ts
sources.finding: Postgres definitions reconciled into BullMQ cron schedulers at startup/mutation; server/Redis own timing.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/environments/providers/provider_registry.ts
sources.finding: Only E2B compute implementation registered in pinned OSS; standalone runner is not another working backend.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/environments/providers/e2b/e2b_provider.ts
sources.finding: Creates E2B Linux sandbox from configured template, timeout15min with autoResume and onTimeout:pause; supports pause/connect/kill and desktop VNC. Network deny policy is not configured in these creation options.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/environments/selection_service.ts
sources.finding: Prefers session then agent environment history, excluding open leases/unhealthy entries. Reuse contradicts README fresh VM every session; current Cloud docs describe a different exact user-agent ownership scheme.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/environments/session_environment.ts
sources.finding: Lease heartbeat60s; injects assigned session secrets as environment variables, then tool variables; exposes PTY IO/resize/kill and public-port URL. Dispose marks lease warm idle.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/environments/terminal/connection_token_service.ts
sources.finding: One-time UUID browser terminal grants expire60s and bind company,user,environment,terminal after prior authorization; not generalized command approval.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/secrets/encryption.ts
sources.finding: AES256GCM with random12byteIV and configured application key hash protects stored secret values; server can decrypt.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/pi-mono/tools/secrets/service.ts
sources.finding: Agent can read plaintext value only if attached to session; available-secret list exposes metadata separately.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/company_member_permission_service.ts
sources.finding: Admin/member active membership gates invites,role management and company deletion; not per-project/task role matrix in OSS.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/graphql/graphql_request_context.ts
sources.finding: Bearer auth yields company transaction scope; dev impersonation headers only when configured dev auth. Local provider authenticates server sessions.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/pi-mono/tools/inbox/ask_human_question.ts
sources.finding: Persists ranked question/proposals and returns immediately; eventual human answer steers current session. A question is not enforced blocking tool approval.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/session_turn_usage_processor.ts
sources.finding: Updates each finalized turn only if usageRecordedAt null and rolls tokens/actual-or-virtual nanoUSD into company,credential,agent,session day/month/total aggregates. OSS excludes Cloud wallet billing; provider cost fields are not invoice reconciliation.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/agent/session/session_turn_usage_service.ts
sources.finding: Production usage enqueue is best effort; failure logs error rather than blocking turn finalization, so accounting completeness is not guaranteed.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/environments/metrics/collection_service.ts
sources.finding: Fetches provider CPU/RAM/disk metrics, stores minute buckets and prunes older than60min; operational host telemetry, not evidence of browser analytics opt-in.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/log/enhanced_logging_service.ts
sources.finding: Enhanced diagnostics require runtime Redis config matching company/component/session/expiry; normal logging remains independent. No PostHog/Sentry sender found in pinned apps/packages search.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/company_deletions/executor.ts
sources.finding: Removes workflow schedules and provider environments before DB company cascade; does not promise deletion of third-party model/log backups.

sources.title: CompanyHelm apps/api/src/services/artifact_service.ts
